_comment: SPA-DEPLOY-ALL-001 — every SiamEPOS Spa deployment, in one place.
scripts/deploy-all.js reads ONLY this file, so adding a client means adding
a row here and nothing else. A client missing from this list is a client
that silently stops getting updates, which is the exact failure we keep hitting.
stage: 0 = demo (always first), 1 = canary (one real shop), 2 = everyone else.
The run stops at the first failure, so a bad build never reaches stage 2.
hold: set to a reason string to skip a tenant. The script prints it loudly
rather than silently passing over it. Remove the key to resume deploys.
netlifySite: ALWAYS passed explicitly with --site. client/.netlify/state.json
points at Jinta, so a bare 'netlify deploy' from client/ ships to the wrong shop.
